members.name: deque
members.doc: deque([iterable[, maxlen]]) --> deque object A list-like sequence optimized for data accesses near its endpoints.

members.name: heappop
members.doc: Pop the smallest item off the heap, maintaining the heap invariant.

members.name: heappush
members.doc: Push item onto heap, maintaining the heap invariant.

members.name: LifoQueue
members.doc: Variant of Queue that retrieves most recently added entries first.

members.name: PriorityQueue
members.doc: Variant of Queue that retrieves open entries in priority order (lowest first). Entries are typically tuples of the form: (priority number, data).

members.name: Queue
members.doc: Create a queue object with a given maximum size. If maxsize is <= 0, the queue size is infinite.

members.name: time
members.doc: monotonic() -> float Monotonic clock, cannot go backward.
